info.name: PromoQuoter API
info.description: Cart pricing and stock reservation service. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner): the create requests save ids into collection variables that later requests use. Start the service first with ./mvnw spring-boot:run (http://localhost:8080). The Rules folder shows the generic rule engine: pricing and validation rules, free gifts, preview and the 422 RULE_VIOLATION. The Rule scenarios folder combines line rules, cart-level discounts, surcharges and stopAfter in one cart. Every error is an RFC 7807 problem with code, requestId and errors[].

request.description: Actuator health endpoint. Returns UP when the service is running.

Creates one or more products in a single all-or-nothing batch (1 to 100). Category is trimmed and upper-cased; price has at most 2 decimals and 10 integer digits. Saves productId (Mug) and lampId (Lamp).

request.description: Re-prices the cart, locks the stock rows, decrements stock and stores an order in one transaction. The optional Idempotency-Key header (max 100 chars) makes retries safe: the same key with the same cart replays the first order and adds Idempotent-Replayed: true. Saves orderId.

request.description: type RULE with a per-cart "when", a per-line "target" and one action. Conditions combine with all, any and not and compare with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, between, in, notIn, startsWith and contains. Stage defaults by action (PERCENT_OFF is 100). Saves ruleId.

A cart-level discount. It is not spread over the lines: the quote shows it under "adjustments" with direction DISCOUNT. It fires only when the cart condition matches (subtotal at least 20.00). Saves cartRuleId.
Adds a fee to every cart. Shown under "adjustments" with direction CHARGE. Saves surchargeRuleId.
stopAfter freezes the lines this rule discounted: later rules (including the 10% kitchen shortcut and the Mugs 2+1 rule) skip those lines. It runs early because of stage 50. Saves exclusiveRuleId.

item.name: Quote: line rule, cart discount and surcharge together

request.description: Mug 12.00 is halved to 6.00 by the exclusive rule and skipped by every later rule; the lamp stays at 30.00. Cart-level rules then run: the voucher takes 3.00 off and the handling fee adds 2.50. Total = 6.00 + 30.00 - 3.00 + 2.50. If the app is started with promoquoter.shipping.flat-fee=5.00, "shipping" shows the fee and a SHIPPING_WAIVER rule removes it.
